messages:
maria: Observed noisy pagers from autofallbacks on high-volume routes. Thinking: switch to digest-first, pager-if-broad. Quick take?
noah: Agree. Two quick caveats: keep a short immutable decision_trace for audits, and a separate redacted sample for UI.
sylvie: UI needs tiny timeline: request -> decision -> returned excerpt. Excerpt must be redacted and size-limited. Show humanized reason + machine code.
ops-bot: policy: schema changes require migration plan + staged rollout. Also any non-redacted excerpts need compliance approval.
maria: Proposed pager rule: only page when unique_routes_impacted_5m >= 5 OR when more than 2 hard-degrade events in 1m. Otherwise send digest to #oncall and pin console.
noah: Implementation: emit flat audit event to our stream with fields: evt_id, ts, route, rollout, decision_code, decision_human, fallback_model, original_model, latency_ms, prompt_sig, excerpt_redacted, redaction_level, telemetry_tags, retention_days. Keep tags flat CSV.
sylvie: For console: add toggle per-rollout "digest mode" (off by default). When on, events get telemetry tag alert_eligible:false. Tooltip explains thresholds. Also add small badge color (red/orange/grey).
oncall: I'll take playbook edits. Also will propose the digest email format and paging thresholds for SRE review.
maria: Action items: noah -> PR for flat audit schema + migration notes, sylvie -> console mock and tooltip copy, oncall -> playbook thresholds. Quick sync next week. :thumbsup:
